title: Open Field Protocol
author: Andrea Vogel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j6qcrdw

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Workspace
steps.instruction: Set up the recording area and workspace for the experiment.

substeps.instruction: Turn on cameras over the two open field boxes, ensuring the whole box is in view.
Insert memory cards into the cameras.
Move a cart into the small room to serve as a workspace.
Place a scale, two plastic beakers, two dry erase boards, and dry erase markers on the cart.

steps.title: Label Animals and Documentation
steps.instruction: Identify the experimental animals and prepare the tracking records.

substeps.instruction: Ensure experimental animals are 8 weeks or older.
Write the first two experimental animals' numbers and the current date on the dry erase boards (one animal per board).
Record the experimental animal's information on the behavior worksheet.

steps.title: Weigh Experimental Animals
steps.instruction: Determine the weight of each animal using the scale.

substeps.instruction: Place a beaker on the scale and zero the scale.
Place one experimental animal in the beaker and record their weight on the behavior worksheet.
Repeat the process for the second animal.

steps.title: Initiate Recording and Animal Placement
steps.instruction: Position the animals in the open field boxes and start the video recording.

substeps.instruction: Bring the beaker containing the animal and its corresponding dry erase board to one of the open field boxes.
Hit record on the camera.
Move the dry erase board into view of the camera and hold for a couple of seconds.
Place the animal in the center of the box.
Repeat these steps for the second animal.

steps.title: Conduct Open Field Test
steps.instruction: Run the behavioral observation for a set duration.

substeps.instruction: Close the door between the two rooms.
Start a timer for 15 minutes.
Record the start time on the behavior worksheet.
After 15 minutes, stop the recording.
Record the stop time on the behavior worksheet.

steps.title: Post-Experiment Cleanup
steps.instruction: Return animals to housing and sanitize equipment.

substeps.instruction: Remove the animals and place them back in their cage.
Clean each open field box and the beakers using 70% ethanol.
Clean off the dry erase boards.
